summary: Consumer status under Consumer Protection Act, 1986; privity of contract; burden of proof on existence of tripartite agreement; deficiency in service; unfair trade practice; liability for unpaid sale consideration; pre-admission dismissal reversed; limitation and necessary party objections; benefit of previous order on consumer status.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; Impugned Order set aside; no liability found on appellant to pay balance consideration; respondent not entitled to refund or compensation.
